newsitem.title: CANADA: NAFTA panel rules in Canada favor in poultry row.
newsitem.headline: NAFTA panel rules in Canada favor in poultry row.

text.p: A trade panel found Canadian tariffs and quotas on dairy, poultry and egg imports from the United States are legal under the North American Free Trade Agreement, a spokeswoman for Canada's Trade Minister said.
"The Minister confirmed the ruling outside the House of Commons today," Nicole Bourget said.
The U.S. argued that even if World Trade Organization rules allow countries to convert import quotas to tariffs the conversion was not allowed under NAFTA.
A preliminary ruling in August had also found in Canada's favor.
